subject: RM_Mullgoth
departures: body is a single low, domed mound with no distinct head, neck or snout: it reads as a hillock, not a quadruped's torso
long pale hair drapes all the way to the ground, nearly hiding four short, thick, hairy legs
the hair is patched with grey-green moss and lilac lichen growing on it like ground cover
black, glistening slime drips from the underside onto the ground
